'''Dav Pold''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Army]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he was stationed at the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Aurek Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], sharing his expertise with other [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Dav Pold appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a class trainer for the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Trooper]] class on Hoth.<ref name="TOR" />
